records.title: Gillett Square, Dalston, London
records.summary: Historic operational site, playground, public square, meeting point, experimental station. Significant period: 2012 era. Known associations: Time Travellers Guild activity, experimental apparatus, public-space performance, Aisha / Holly, Toby, milk float, early Time Machine work. A place accumulates temporal density through repeated events.
records.jack_note: The square is real. The case on the float is not closed.

records.title: Dalston

records.title: Station
records.summary: A Station is a place where Guild activity becomes deliberately accessible. Stations can be physical, digital, temporary, mobile or ceremonial. A website can be a station. A public square can be a station. A room can be a station. A festival can temporarily become a station. A person should not generally be called a station.
records.jack_note: You are not a station. You may stand in one.
